messages:
gabi: Postmortem follow-up: we keep seeing large blast radii from feature flag ramps. Proposing a compact "Sheriff" checklist + metadata schema to make rollouts safer. Need owners.

gabi: Quick proposal:
- Sheriff pre-ramp probe (1% traffic, 5m) with p95 + 5xx + anomaly checks
- Flag metadata: rollback_safe, owner, max_rollout_pct, default_scope
- Containment runbook: quarantine + rollback 0% + contact matrix
- Per-flag telemetry: activation histogram + burn-rate alert + weekly blast KPI

harry: I'll own Sheriff pre-ramp probe and CI gate. Plan: probe 1% for 5m, compare to rolling 30m baseline, fail -> hold and page. ETA 8d.

irene: I can define flag metadata and naming conv. Suggest <service>.<area>.<feature>.<env>. Default max_rollout_pct=5% for prod. ETA 4d.

john: Containment runbook owner here. Will write step-by-step CLI commands, dashboard links, and a "quarantine" flag state. ETA 6d.

kate: Telemetry dashboards + blast KPI. Will add EWMA baseline for low-traffic flags and a weekly KPI for average impacted pct. ETA 10d.

gabi: On auto-rollback: default OFF for stateful flags. Require rollback_safe=true in metadata to enable automatic rollback. Otherwise Sheriff holds and pages.

harry: Sheriff config draft (WIP):
```yaml
sheriff:
  probe_pct: 1
  probe_minutes: 5
  baseline_minutes: 30
  triggers:
    - metric: five_xx_pct
      absolute_increase: 2.0
      duration_mins: 5
    - metric: p95_latency
      multiplier: 1.8
      duration_mins: 5
  on_fail: hold_and_page
```

irene: Will include owner tag so alerts page the right team. Also adding max_rollout_pct per-env.

john: Runbook note: when stateful migrations are involved, do NOT auto-rollback; instead 0% and manual mitigation. Add an explicit audit log step.

kate: Dashboards will surface per-flag activation hist, traffic split, and a one-click "quarantine" button tied to the runbook.

gabi: Next: owners update tickets with blockers and a minimal PR list by EOD Wed. We'll have a policy review Thurs 11:00. Goal: reduce median blast size by 50% next quarter.

harry: pinging infra about probe quotas.

irene: will draft naming doc and add examples to the template PR.

john: will reach out to oncall to validate runbook steps.

gabi: thanks all. Short sync Thurs 11:00 for policy signoff.
